task.title: Delete dialog destination-set design: offer surviving descendants and ReturnToPrevious
task.description: Filed from the P6-189 adversarial review (2026-08-10). Two design questions about the delete confirm's haves picker, both deliberate omissions in P6-189: (1) the picker copies the move picker's self+subtree exclusion, but post-P6-188 descendants SURVIVE re-parented, so a surviving child is a legitimate destination the dialog cannot offer — the planner/executor already accept it (only the subject id is rejected); decide whether the exclusion should narrow to just the subject. (2) HaveDisposition::ReturnToPrevious is implemented server-side and the spec says offering it 'costs almost nothing', but the dialog exposes only parent/named/discard; decide whether to add it as a third pinned row. Both are copy+picker-row changes, no backend work. Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md (step 4).
